findings.summary: Main went red after the freeze, and the completion gate refuses the freeze sha. ci 43505770693 ran on f6aeace (product tree equal to ffc89e8) at 2026-11-13T20:54Z, after f6aeace's record had already said the freeze 'holds'. It failed security / osv-scanner on astro 7.3.5 (the catalog pin, used by apps/docs): GHSA-mh32-jxcr-mh9f (CVSS 2.3, fixed in 7.4.5) and GHSA-r3h5-4585-7x3w (CVSS 6.3, fixed in 7.4.7). ci-ok failed with it. These advisories were not reported on ffc89e8's or 2eb3d4f's ci (43387832078 and 43394380743 both succeeded), so they are newly published. check-ci-evidence reads every ci run on the recorded product tree, and its leg now refuses: 'job security / osv-scanner failure in ci run 43505770693 at f6aeace on the same product tree, green in 0 later run(s) of 2 needed'. Under the cp50/cp51 freeze rule, any fix is code. That covers an astro bump in the lockfile, and also an osv-scanner.toml exemption, which is not in AFTER_REVIEW_PATHS. Either one moves the code floor past the evidence nightly, so mutation evidence goes stale, and past this review's range end, so checkFinalReview's onlyBookkeepingAfter refuses this record.

findings.failure_scenario: The driver records this final review over ..ffc89e8 and tries to close M18.43. Either the ci-evidence leg stays red, or a quick osv ignore or astro bump lands as 'M18.43 bookkeeping'. That commit is not bookkeeping: checkFinalReview and mutation provenance then refuse, or worse, a mis-scoped exemption is argued through and M18 closes on a main whose security scan is red.

findings.summary: The gate and the skill spell the hand-off disposition differently, and the gate never checks a hand-off's target. DISPOSITIONS is ['reopen', 'hand-off', 'argue', 'supersede'], while SKILL.md and every M18 checkpoint record (cp51 F4 and F6, for example) use 'hand off'. Only the final record is shape-checked, so the drift is invisible until a final record copies the checkpoint spelling and the 'independent final review covers M18' leg fails on shape. That is a false red, not a false green. Separately, reviewShapeProblem and checkBacklogDone verify only that reopen targets are done. A hand-off whose M<k>.md row and roadmap Deferred entry were never written passes the gate. All M18 hand-offs exist today, which this review checked by script, so nothing is lost now. M8 final F3 argued the spelling as 'a harness wording change, for a harness milestone', and that change has not happened since.

findings.failure_scenario: A later milestone's final review hands a real defect to M<k+1>. The driver never adds the row, the gate goes green, and the defect drops out of every plan. That is the silent-drop that hand-off exists to prevent.

dispositions.note: New row M18.296, fix-first and `blocks-landing` ahead of M18.43: 'Main green again: astro advisories GHSA-mh32-jxcr-mh9f and GHSA-r3h5-4585-7x3w at f6aeace (ci 43505770693)'. The fix should be an astro catalog bump to 7.4.7 or later, with the docs build and docs e2e green, carrying Fixes-ci: 43505770693. An osv exemption is acceptable only with a reason and an expiry, as the existing ones have, and it is still code. The fix commit is the new freeze sha. Then: one nightly at or after it (check-mutation-evidence --record and check-ci-evidence --record <new sha> --perf-run <id>, reading first render under the cp51 M18.288 rule, with no re-run counted); the browser legs re-run at the new sha; and a final-review delta over ffc89e8..<new sha>, recorded as a final record with range 7545e708..<new sha> that cites this one, because checkFinalReview requires the range end to be the last non-bookkeeping commit. Before each closing record, read last-ci immediately, because an advisory database can redden an unchanged tree.

Row in docs/milestones/M19.md and a roadmap Deferred entry. checkFinalReview and checkBacklogDone accept one spelling, and the skill and gate agree on it. Each hand-off disposition with an M<k> target in any of the milestone's reviews needs an M<k>.md row and a roadmap Deferred entry that cite '<checkpoint> <finding>'. A harness test covers a missing row. This record uses the gate's 'hand-off' spelling so its own leg can pass.

questions.coherence: Coherent at milestone level. The feature line stays one design throughout. ADR-0048 to 0051 come first, then the pack schema and lazy loader, then the pure-format SVG conversion (ADR-0187/0188) with the shipped witness hosts (ADR-0189), then font retention and subsetting (ADR-0192, 0051), then the twelve packs, My shapes, replace, and pack connectors across the studio, CLI and player (M18.250-252, M18.233, M18.147). Most rows are harness and CI hardening. Each traces to a named checkpoint finding (cp12 to cp51), and the later rows refine earlier ones rather than contradict them (last-ci, land.mjs, same-tree evidence, blocks-landing). The 2eb3d4f/f6aeace delta agrees with cp51: the freeze sha, the bookkeeping-only rule and the outcome rules were written before the readings they decide. The one seam is between records and reality after f6aeace (F1). Another is the disposition spelling between the skill and the gate (F2).
questions.specFidelity: Every plan task (1 to 17, 1a to 1c) has a gate leg bound to the suite that owns it, and the legs were rebound when ownership moved: the batch leg moved to format and CLI (cp9 F3), artwork and loader legs moved (M18.71), and the CLI subset e2e was added (M18.204). Locally green: check-trace M/S, the four ADRs plus 0171, the three threshold constants unchanged, all 12 pack legs, Iconify, draw.io at 90 percent or more, embed-used 3 of 5000, the font subset at 60000 bytes or less, replace-shape, pack connectors, licences and attribution, catalog budget, the cloud-architecture golden, docs, no open spec folders or quarantines, and changesets. Mutation evidence: 287 partitions plus the aggregate at unchanged floors (core 90.8 against 90). The three-browser legs (209/209) were recorded at ffc89e8 on Huy's machine in the pinned image with --retries=0. No requirement was silently dropped: FR-LIB-010, .fluxpack and document import stay out of scope as planned, and the open engine-specific reds are ADR-0202 and ADR-0215 Deferred entries. Spot checks: embed-used asserts exactly the used ids from a 5000-definition source; font-subset reads FONT_SUBSET_LATIN_MAX_BYTES from thresholds.mjs; replace-shape asserts that all four connectors stay bound after rect becomes ellipse. A mutant that drops a binding or embeds every definition fails each of these.
questions.standardsDrift: In the delta, both commits stay within AFTER_REVIEW_PATHS, the digest has M18.43 r1 and r2 with the reviewer label claude:isolated-subagent (cp51 F5's label rule), Commit cells are filled for M18.288 (3a49253), M18.290 (50caef4) and M18.291 (ffc89e8), and blockedReason names the current state and 'Rows left: M18.43'. That is the first record in many checkpoints whose state.json is not stale. No threshold, floor or baseline changed: BIG_SCREEN_FIRST_RENDER_MS, the mutation floors and COLD_SETUP_MAX_MS are untouched. Across the milestone, the gate's history in the range shows only rebindings and strengthenings; no leg was removed. The drift left is the disposition spelling (F2).
questions.gateHonesty: m18-complete is honest. It cannot go green at f6aeace, and it correctly refuses now. The legs still red before closeout are M18.43 todo, the missing final review, the roadmap still at M18, and the browser and verify legs on this host. It also caught F1, which the records had not seen: same-tree evidence reads every ci run on the product tree, including the one f6aeace's own push started. checkFinalReview refuses any non-bookkeeping M18 commit after the range end, so the fix F1 needs cannot be slipped under this record. Mutation provenance makes the evidence stale on any lockfile change. Residual gaps: the verdict string and hand-off targets are not checked (F2; the verdict part was argued at M0 final F5), and the browser legs depend on the host that runs them. That is why the closing 76/76 must come from one run in the pinned image at the final sha, as cp50 F5 requires.
questions.architecture: Layering held: check-layering ran inside the verify ladder, recorded green on CI at ffc89e8 (ci 43387832078 verify on three OS). SVG conversion stays in pure format behind injected paint witnesses (ADR-0187). The font engines are lazy WASM in studio and CLI and absent from the player (ADR-0051). The CLI and player gained pack connector rendering through the existing registry, not a new public API outside check-api. Contract changes each carried an ADR: pack format v1, embedded subset sources, and attribution in saved files. The dependency changes in the late range are overrides for advisories (M18.289) and the tzap bump (dev-only). F1 will need one more, astro for apps/docs, which is a docs-site dependency, not a player one.
questions.planHealth: 283 rows against 43 planned (6.6x), far past 1.5x. The feature rows are near plan, about 50 including decomposition: M18.14 split into 73-76, M18.16 into 79-81, M18.80 into 83-85 and M18.81 into 94-97. Over 200 rows are qualification and harness: mutation execution and its nightly evidence (M18.10, 49-57, 286-287), parallel-stream landing safety (M18.99, 106, 117-123, 134-135, 160, 191-201), CI time and cold setup (M18.157, 182-189, 277-283, 290), and flake fixes found on three OS. The growth came from running parallel streams against a capacity-bound three-OS CI and a 14-hour mutation nightly, not from scope creep. Later milestones should budget qualification separately and declare a code freeze up front, and expect an external input such as an advisory database to move during the evidence window (F1).

planDelta: One new M18 row: M18.296 (F1), fix-first and `blocks-landing` before M18.43. It resolves the astro advisories that reddened ci 43505770693 at f6aeace, and its commit becomes the new freeze sha. Order: (1) M18.296 lands with Fixes-ci: 43505770693, and main's next ci is green, osv-scanner included. (2) The first nightly at or after the new freeze: check-mutation-evidence --record, check-ci-evidence --record <new sha> --perf-run <id>, and first render read under the cp51 M18.288 rule, with no re-run counted. (3) The browser legs re-run at the new sha in the pinned image. (4) A final-review delta over ffc89e8..<new sha>, written as milestone-M18-final.json with range 7545e708..<new sha>. (5) last-ci read again right before M18.43's close, then m18-complete 76/76 in one run on one tree, then the roadmap advance. One M19 row and roadmap Deferred entry: F2 (one disposition spelling, and hand-off targets verified by the gate). Learned: "final (through `ffc89e8`): every evidence leg was green at the freeze, and the records said the freeze held. But an advisory published that evening reddened main's security scan on the unchanged tree within minutes of the last record, and the gate's same-tree read caught it where the records did not. A freeze stops our changes, not the world's, so an evidence window must re-read main right before each closing record."
